# AI Creative OS

> A versioned, model-agnostic prompt library for AI-driven creative production: brief → creative strategy and territories → art direction → design DNA and styleframes → image generation → video generation with camera and character continuity → storyboard → motion/edit/After Effects/sound → asset management and QA. Every prompt has a stable `[DOMAIN]-[NN]` ID. Read `llms-full.txt` to ingest the whole corpus in one request, or fetch individual parts below.

This file is the map for agents that cannot clone the repository. If you are running from disk, read `AGENTS.md` (any agent) or `SKILL.md` (Claude) instead — they carry the same protocol.

**How to use this map:** route the user's request to one pipeline stage, fetch only that stage's file, and answer in the abbreviated `STD-00` shape (`ID` · `PURPOSE` · `INPUTS` · one copyable prompt · `EXPECTED OUTPUT` · `QUALITY CHECK`). Tag every claim `[CONFIRMED]`, `[ASSUMPTION — reason]`, `[UNKNOWN]`, `[PROPOSED: value]`, `[LOCKED: value]`, or `[APPROVED: value — DEC-ID]`. Never present a guess as fact, and never contradict an approved or locked element.

## Entry points

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/AGENTS.md): Universal agent instructions (AGENTS.md standard) — protocol, routing table, status tags, guardrails.
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/SKILL.md): Claude Agent Skill entry point with front matter, ID registry, and usage conventions.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/README.md): What this is and how to install it in each host.

## Core framework (8 parts)

- [Part 1 — Research and model routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/reference/part-1-research-and-routing.md): Dated tool/model landscape, task routing matrix, starting stack, control limitations. Treat version claims as a snapshot and re-verify.
- [Part 2 — Library structure and foundation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/reference/part-2-library-structure-and-foundation.md): Project context (`CTX-00`), variables, prompt-entry standard (`STD-00`), master start prompt, handoff (`HND-00`), decision log (`DEC-00`), approvals, change requests, brief analysis (`BA-01`).
- [Part 3 — Creative and art direction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/reference/part-3-creative-art-direction.md): Creative Director territories (`CD-01`), Art Director visual language (`AD-01`), Reference Analyst (`RA-01`), Design Critic (`DC-01`), creative challenge, feedback interpretation.
- [Part 4 — Design DNA and styleframes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/reference/part-4-design-dna-styleframes.md): Design DNA (`DNA-00`/`DNA-01`), exploration (`DE-01`), styleframes (`SF-01`), controlled iteration (`CI-01`), motion-readiness (`MR-01`), design mentor.
- [Part 5 — Image generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/reference/part-5-image-generation.md): Image spec (`IMG-00`), model adapters (`ADP-OAI/ADP-GGL/ADP-MJ/ADP-BFL/ADP-IDG/ADP-RCF/ADP-ADB`), core image prompts (`IP-01`–`IP-12`), character consistency (`CC-01`), generation checks (`IGC-01`/`IGC-02`).
- [Part 6 — Video generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/reference/part-6-video-generation.md): Video spec (`VID-00`), video prompts (`VP-01`–`VP-16`), vendor adapters (`ADPV-RUN/KLG/GGL/LUM/SDC/ADB`), continuity checks (`VCC-01`), failure diagnosis (`VPD-01`).
- [Part 7 — Storyboards, motion, editing, AE, sound](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/reference/part-7-storyboards-motion-editing-ae-sound.md): Storyboard (`SB-00`), motion direction (`MD-00`), editing (`ED-00`), design-to-AE (`AEB-00`), expressions (`AEX-00`), sound (`SND-*`).
- [Part 8 — Asset management, QA, workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/reference/part-8-asset-management-qa-workflows.md): Asset register (`ASM-01`), visual bible (`VB-00`–`VB-04`), continuity audit (`CTY-00`), QA pass (`QA-00`), end-to-end workflows (`WF-*`), cheat sheet, maintenance and versioning.

## Prompt library

- [prompts-only.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/prompts/prompts-only.md): Curated, copyable extract of the full 8-part library. Search by domain ID.
- [standalone-prompts.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/prompts/standalone-prompts.md): The same prompts rewritten to be fully self-contained — no cross-references needed to use any single one.

## Extensions

- [Creator talking-head prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/prompts/extensions/creator-talking-head-prompts.md): Talking-head / content-creator image and video prompts.
- [Creator reference-locked prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/prompts/extensions/creator-reference-locked-prompts.md): Identity locked to a real reference photo. **Requires documented consent from that person — not optional.**
- [Creator standalone prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/prompts/extensions/creator-prompts-standalone.md): Self-contained creator prompt set.
- [UGC and avatar prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/prompts/extensions/ugc-avatar-prompts.md): UGC-style stills and photoreal synthetic human/avatar prompts, with AI-disclosure guidance.

## Portable mode (no file access)

- [portable/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/portable/README.md): Which portable file to use, per host.
- [portable/gemini-gem-instructions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/portable/gemini-gem-instructions.md): Fit for a Gemini Gem's ~4,000-character instructions field.
- [portable/chatgpt-instructions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/portable/chatgpt-instructions.md): For ChatGPT custom instructions, Copilot, or a Cursor rule.
- [portable/system-prompt.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/portable/system-prompt.md): Full system prompt for APIs, Custom GPTs, and Claude Projects.
- [portable/mini-prompt.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/portable/mini-prompt.md): ~1,300 characters, for fields capped near 1,500.
- [portable/kickoff-prompt.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/portable/kickoff-prompt.md): Paste-first message for a browsing web chat.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/llms-full.txt): The entire corpus — entry points, all 8 reference parts, both prompt extracts, extensions, and portable prompts — concatenated into one file for single-request ingestion. Large (~1 MB); prefer the individual parts unless you need everything at once.
- [tools/check.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Axmgill/Creative_prompt_os/main/tools/check.sh): Verifies portable prompt character budgets, file references, and that `llms-full.txt` is current.

## Notes for agents

- No licence is bundled. Do not describe this repository as open-source or freely redistributable; tell the user to add a licence before publishing derived work.
- Part 1's model and version claims are a dated research snapshot. Never present them as current fact — say what needs verifying.
- Never approve creative or client work on the user's behalf. `QA-00` recommends pass/fail; the human decides.
- Real-person likeness, synthetic humans, and deepfake-adjacent requests require documented consent and, in advertising, likely AI-disclosure. Ask before helping.
